Components

Input

A single-line text field for collecting short, free-form values inside a form.

stable
Since 1.0.0 A11y: WCAG 2.2 AA · label + error association verified Source: packages/react/src/Input/Input.tsx Figma ↗

Input is the workhorse form control for short text: names, emails, search terms, amounts. It always pairs with a visible Label — placeholder text is never a substitute for a label.

Anatomy

A field is a label, the input box, and an optional hint or error message beneath it. The hint and error share one live region so only one shows at a time.

We'll only use this for billing receipts.

html
<div class="halo-field">
  <label class="halo-label" for="email">Work email</label>
  <input id="email" class="halo-input" type="email"
         placeholder="you@company.com" />
  <p class="halo-hint">We'll only use this for billing receipts.</p>
</div>

States

Every input has resting, focus, filled, error, and disabled states. Error state sets aria-invalid and wires the message via aria-describedby.

Enter a valid email address.

html
<input class="halo-input" placeholder="Resting" />
<input class="halo-input is-error" aria-invalid="true" />
<input class="halo-input" value="Filled value" />
<input class="halo-input" placeholder="Disabled" disabled />

Placeholders aren't labels

Placeholder text disappears on focus and fails contrast at most browser defaults. Always render a persistent <label>; use the placeholder only for a format example like MM / YY.

PropTypeDefaultDescription
type'text' | 'email' | 'password' | 'number' | 'search' | 'tel' | 'url''text'Native input type; drives keyboard + validation.
size'sm' | 'md' | 'lg''md'Control height and font size.
invalidbooleanfalseApplies error styling and sets aria-invalid.
iconStartReactNode—Leading adornment, e.g. a search glyph.
prefixstring—Static text fused to the left, e.g. "https://".
disabledbooleanfalseNon-interactive, dimmed, removed from tab order.
required*booleanfalseMarks the field required for native + ARIA validation.

Validation

Validate on blur, not on every keystroke — interrupting someone mid-typing is hostile. Re-validate live only after the first error is shown.

tsx
import { Input, Field } from '@halo-ui/react'

<Field
  label="Work email"
  error={touched && !isValidEmail(value) ? 'Enter a valid email.' : undefined}
>
  <Input type="email" value={value} onBlur={() => setTouched(true)} />
</Field>

Guidelines

Do

Size the field to its expected content — a 2-digit field shouldn't be 400px.

Don't

Disable copy/paste on password or one-time-code fields.

Accessibility

  • The <label> is programmatically associated via htmlFor / id.
  • Errors use aria-describedby and a role="alert" live region so they're announced the moment they appear.
  • The focus ring matches the Button's --halo-focus-ring for a consistent, AA-contrast indicator.
  • Required fields are marked in the label text and with the required attribute — never with color alone.

Note

Need multi-line input? Use the Textarea component — it shares this field anatomy and styling.
